aggregation_stories.title: Tyra’s one-drug, three-indication bet nears its first phase 2 test
aggregation_stories.summary: Tyra Biosciences is on the verge of its first Phase 2 clinical test for dabogratinib, an oral FGFR3 inhibitor.
